caption: The drawing depicts a large, round, brown jar with a wide mouth, sitting on a wooden surface. The jar has a glossy finish with dark, irregular blotches and lighter specks scattered around its surface. In front of the jar, there is a matching brown, circular lid with a small knob handle, also decorated with dark spots, positioned flat on the same wooden surface. The background is a plain, off-white color with the text “JAR WITH COVER” written across the top in uppercase letters. The overall coloration consists mainly of shades of brown, with the jar and lid both having a reddish-brown tone accented by darker and lighter areas.
title: Covered Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
